response.overview: The story of this film begins after Sazali finished serving his prison sentence for a criminal offense. When married, he does not want his son to practice free association as he went through until he becomes a useless person to society. For that Sazali locked up his son Farid so that he wouldn't mix with other boys and hired a teacher to teach his son in the room. That action made Farid become too shy and afraid to meet the outside community. To overcome his shyness, a kind of shyness pill was given which made Farid become shameless and do anything without feeling.
response.tagline: When humans seek perfection to an excessive degree...
response.title: Anaknya Sazali
